subject: Datadog + Redwood: OTEL relay plugin maintenance & MOA
messages:
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datadoghq.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Datadog + Redwood: OTEL relay plugin maintenance & MOA

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. I wanted to follow up with a concise proposal for how Datadog would like to collaborate on the OTLP/OTEL relay plugin you shipped (rdw-dd-otel-relay). We’ve seen a handful of customers running the integration in mixed-hosted/dedicated environments and a few operational edge cases are recurring: sample-rate drift across proxies, tag-key normalization mismatch, and a high-cardinality metric set coming from some quantization configs.

High level proposal:
- Shared maintenance model (Datadog + Redwood) for the plugin with a documented triage rotation.
- Two SLA tiers for the plugin: community support (best-effort) + enterprise maintenance (24x5 triage, 48h patch objective).
- A documented compatibility matrix for Datadog Agent versions, OTEL Collector config, and known broken combos (we’ll contribute initial matrix).
- Co-owned tests + CI job in your repo that validates telemetry ingestion across a small e2e harness we’ll provide.

I attached a short technical spec (rdw-dd-otel-relay-v1.md) showing the edge cases we care about and a proposed minimal compatibility matrix. If you’re open, we can draft a short Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) that covers ownership, SLAs, triage rotation, and co-marketing commitments.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick sync (30 min) to align on scope and triage model — can you do Thu 13th 10:00 PT?
2) We’ll drop a starter MOA + SLA PDF for review.
3) Technical kickoff for the CI tests and instrumentation mapping.

Thanks — looking forward.

Sara
Sara Liu
Technical Partnerships — Observability Integrations
Datadog

Attachments: rdw-dd-otel-relay-v1.md (text/markdown)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datadoghq.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Datadog + Redwood: OTEL relay plugin maintenance & MOA

Sara —

Appreciate the write-up and the spec, this matches what we discussed. We’re interested in a cooperative maintenance model (especially if we can keep the maintenance burden bounded). A few quick internal notes:

- Marcus and Jonas will own the technical rollout on our side; Vanessa will lead commercial/MOA negotiation.
- We want the CI tests to run as part of PR checks for the plugin — low-friction, no proprietary credentials required.
- For the triage rotation, we prefer a 2-week on-call window with a named POC from each org and postmortem expectations for severity >= P2.

Proposed immediate deliverables from our side:
1) Mutual Action Plan (attached) that splits responsibilities: code fixes, release cadence, security disclosure path, and breach of SLA remedies.
2) A short SOW-ish paragraph for commercial to put into a MOA draft.

I’m ok with Thu 13th 10:00 PT. Can the Datadog team share the earliest MOA draft and a proposed SLA PDF before the call? That’ll let Vanessa and our legal review quickly.

Also — we should create a shared Slack channel and a small Miro board for the e2e scenarios.

Best,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Head of Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Mutual_Action_Plan_20270511.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Sara Liu <sara.liu@datadoghq.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Diego Martinez <diego@observ-labs.io>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Datadog + Redwood: OTEL relay plugin maintenance & MOA

Aisha —

Thanks — attaching a short SLA proposal (DD_SLA_Proposal_v1.pdf) and a starter MOA draft via DocuSign link. Highlights from our side:
- Enterprise maintenance: 24x5 triage, 48-hour patch objective for P1/P2, security disclosure process with 72-hour initial ack.
- Co-marketing: two joint webinars per year, joint case study if >3 customers adopt.
- Code ownership: plugin remains in Redwood’s repo but Datadog gets commit rights on the integrations/ directory; code of conduct + CLA required for contributors.

Tech notes (short):
- We’ll ship an e2e harness (containerized) that posts synthetic traces + metrics through the relay. Please ensure it can run without AWS creds — it should target local OTLP/gRPC endpoints.
- For sampling drift: we recommend exposing an explicit sample-rate header and a config knob in the relay to enforce server-side sampling.
- Metric naming: Datadog prefers dot-separated metric names for legacy pipelines; we’ve added a mapping layer recommendation in the MOA.

DocuSign draft: https://docusign.com/rdw-dd-moa-draft
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1234567 (we’ve created a partner opportunity so our GTM folks can triage comms).

Proposed kickoff: Thu 13 May 2027 10:00 PT — we’ll send a calendar invite.

—Sara

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Datadog + Redwood: OTEL relay plugin maintenance & MOA

Thanks Sara — and Diego, thanks for the willingness to consult on the e2e harness. Quick notes from our tech sync prep:

Agenda for Thu 13 May 10:00 PT (we’ll add 10 mins buffer):
- 10:00–10:10 Introductions + scope (Aisha / Sara)
- 10:10–10:25 Compatibility matrix & CI gating (Jonas / Diego)
- 10:25–10:40 Sampling & metric-mapping design (Marcus / Datadog engineer)
- 10:40–10:55 Triage rotation + SLA signoffs (Vanessa / Sara)
- 10:55–11:00 Next steps & action items

Pre-flight ask for the call:
1) Sara — can you paste the short sample-rate header name Datadog prefers and an example of the mapping rule?
2) Diego — please share a short docker-compose snippet we can run locally to hit the relay.

Example snippet we’ll test (pseudo):

POST /v1/traces HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:4317
Content-Type: application/x-protobuf
X-Redwood-Sample: 0.25

(we’ll validate that the relay propagates X-Redwood-Sample into dd.sample_rate tag)

I’ll coordinate calendars and create the Slack channel redwood-datadog-otel. Also tagging our legal team to review the MOA when Vanessa shares the link.

Marcus Lin
Senior Director, Serving Integrations
Redwood Inference

— Marcus (sent on behalf of the integration team)
